info.title: calver
info.description: Calculate calendar versions from Git commit dates.

options.name: --format
options.description:
YYYY.MM.PATCH    CalVer format using tokens: YYYY,
YY, 0Y, MM, 0M, WW, 0W, DD, 0D,
PATCH

options.name: --folder
options.description:
Repository-relative folder whose
commits determine the version

options.name: --prerelease
options.description:
Prerelease identifier (e.g.,
alpha, beta, rc)
in the version

options.name: --buildmetadata
options.description:
Include build metadata (short SHA)
in the version

options.name: --output
options.description: Text             Output format: text or json
